exclusions.App.tsx: Application composition root that installs providers, router, and globals; it has no isolated visual contract beyond its child surfaces.
exclusions.components/auth/AuthProvider.tsx: Authentication lifecycle bootstrap and children wrapper with no standalone visual state or independently catalogable UI.
exclusions.components/chat/mod/UserPopout/UserPopou: Context and dispatcher wiring whose user-facing surface is the separately storyable UserPopout component.
exclusions.components/chat/twitch/ModerationFixture: Development-only query-string status banner gated by import.meta.env.DEV; the production Storybook build cannot activate it without changing its environment contract.
exclusions.components/player/kick/uptime-readout.ts: Imperative ref-driven clock that returns null and only updates a media progress element outside a visual component contract.
exclusions.components/player/persistent-player-shel: Persistent player context registrations and children wrapper with no independently rendered interface to document in Storybook.
exclusions.components/stream/related-content.tsx: Backward-compatibility re-export shim with no component implementation; the actual RelatedContent surface lives in related-content/index.tsx.
exclusions.dev-relay/twitch-ad-frame-proof-panel.ts: Imperative development proof harness that exposes a mount API rather than a product UI with a stable visual contract.
exclusions.hooks/use-stream-recording-state.tsx: State store hook for recording status and live-clock updates; it provides no standalone visual surface to render in Storybook.
exclusions.pages/Mod/channel/ModChannelKickPage.tsx: Route adapter that delegates to the shared channel page instead of defining a distinct visual interface.
exclusions.pages/Mod/channel/ModChannelTwitchPage.t: Route adapter that delegates to the shared channel page instead of defining a distinct visual interface.
exclusions.providers/query-provider.tsx: Application React Query bootstrap provider with development instrumentation rather than a standalone user-facing visual surface.
exclusions.renderer.tsx: DOM bootstrap entry point that mounts the application and has no component surface for Storybook to document.
exclusions.routes/router.tsx: Route-tree configuration that composes actual pages inline rather than exporting a separately storyable visual component.
